findings.title: Wrong primary lightness in dark-light-choose for embedded post author link
findings.body: This rule previously used `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The replacement keeps the dark-scheme value for `$secondary` at 30%, but changes the light-scheme `$primary` value to 70% instead of preserving the original 30%. As a result, embedded post metadata author links become much lighter than before in light themes, and the dark-theme value is not the complement expected from the old 30% value. It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: Inverted primary/secondary lightness values for custom message length
findings.body: This rule previously used `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`. The replacement is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`, which inverts the intended mapping. The first argument should preserve the original 70% primary lightness, and the dark-scheme secondary value should be 30%, i.e. `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`. As written, the light theme color becomes much darker than before.
